description:
Send a WhatsApp notification to the account owner's own phone.

        `text` is the message (1-1024 chars). `image_url` (optional) is a public https
        image link — a screenshot, chart or diff — delivered as an image with `text` as
        the caption when the user's 24h window is open (otherwise text only). Returns a
        confirmation with the queued message id; raises an actionable error on quota/auth.
        `to` (optional): "me" (default), "team" (the owner plus every active team member)
        or a list of team member names or ids (and "me"); one message per recipient.
        `ack` (optional): an "On it" button on each copy inside the 24h window; to a team
        the first tap wins and the others are told who took it (read it via
        `check_replies`).
        `escalate` (optional, with `ack`): while nobody taps, send on to the next people:
        up to 3 steps {"to": "team" or [member names/ids], "after_s": seconds after the
        send, >= 60, each >= 60 after the previous}, or a policy name (POST
        /v1/team/policies). The first tap stops it.
        `actions` (optional): buttons under the alert, up to 3: an action id (one of the
        number's actions), "ack" (the "On it" button, instead of `ack`), "snooze" (mutes
        `topic` for 1h) or {"snooze": minutes}. A tap runs the action with `ref` as its
        context. `topic` (optional): what the alert is about (letters, digits, . _ : / -),
        needed by a snooze; while snoozed, sends with it are suppressed. `ref` (optional):
        your own string (an incident id), sent back with an action's run.
name: notify
